item.title: Vote clarified for 2026 fireworks season
item.description: The Newton Kansan reported Jan. 28 at thekansan.com a motion to limit fireworks sales and discharge to four days in 2026 carried 3-2, with Jason Miller, Kathy Valentine and Melanie Watson voting in favor. Leory Koehn and Richard Stinnett voted against.
